rules.statement: A person who applies for the extraordinary remedy of Writ must come with clean hands and must not suppress any relevant facts from Court. He must refrain from making any misleading or incorrect statements to Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "on an application for relief the utmost good faith is required and if the applicant in his affidavit suppress the material facts the Court will refuse an Order without going into the merits."

meta.parties: Biso Menika v. Cyril Alwis and Others
